notes.title: PATCH 1.1.2
notes.content:
Small patches and a small new feature

Changelog:
- Added a god spot for the signal booster - 50% chance to spawn in a certain location HINT: [spoiler]Requires Mechanical Lockpick[/spoiler]
- Changed the text in the hold your breath minigame to indicate better that you have to spam space
- You no longer have to click on camVIEW to be able to use the keyboard to switch cams, now only your mouse has to be over the window in order for it to work
- Fixed a small issue where the credits would stay on screen

notes.title: PATCH 1.1.1
notes.content:
Found a couple bugs today, hopefully these are the last bugs.

Changelog:
- Fixed a bug where the signal booster wasn't required in order to access the secret cameras
- Fixed a bug where the first location wouldn't load sometimes
- Made small tweaks to Twitch Integration

notes.title: UPDATE 1.1
notes.content:
Hey Everyone, today I bring you the first major update for The Last Sight

[b]New Gamemode - Casual[/b]
- 60 Required Reports
- No enemies
- Fast anomaly spawn rate

[b]Cameras Rework - Gas Station and Office[/b]
- The Gas Station interior has been heavily improved, adding a lot of new props to make it feel more realistic
- The Office was reworked, the wooden cabinets have been replaced by different metal ones that fit the setting more

[b]Minor changes:[/b]
- Added a lot of ambient sound effects
- Added 2 new achievements
- Fixed lumen rendering on cameras
- Fixed a bug where the kidnapper could still kill you in the closet during the ending

notes.title: PATCH 1.0.7
notes.content:
Changelog:
- Fixed rare instances where the R00T_K1T popup would appear for a split second
- Fixed a bug where the "Hold your breath" minigame would stay during the nightmare ending
- Fixed a bug where you could still get a game over for too many anomalies during the nightmare ending

notes.title: PATCH 1.0.6
notes.content:
- You can now skip the menu intro by pressing SPACE
- Fixed instances where some disappearance and extra object anomalies could be confused with the object displacement anomaly
- Fixed an issue where the audio settings weren't applying to the menu sounds
- The settings in the menu have been rearranged and split into 3 different categories: Graphics, Game and Audio
- The settings in the pause menu have also been split into the 3 categories mentioned above
- Fixed a bug where the R00T_K1T menu would stay when a signal change occurs

notes.title: PATCH 1.0.5
notes.content:
Nerfed the "Hold your breath" minigame a lot, should be easier now

We also released the game's soundtrack on Steam, you can grab it here now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3128750/The_Last_Sight_Soundtrack/

notes.title: PATCH 1.0.4
notes.content:
Small patch to improve some elements of the game

Changelog:
- Added settings to the pause menu
- The closet and kidnapper search have been reworked, they're much shorter, but you now need to "hold the breath" inside the closet
- Added audio settings, split into 3 categories: Music, SFX and Voice
- Fixed a bug where the kidnapper would clip through the fence
- Fixed a bug where sometimes the game would remain on the black screen after completing it

notes.title: HOTFIX 1.0.3
notes.content: Fixed a bug where the kidnapper would kill you even if you hid in the closet - genuinely sorry about that

notes.title: HOTFIX 1.0.2
notes.content: It appears that there's an issue where you couldn't drag camVIEW, here's a hotfix to fix that

notes.title: Patch v1.0.1
notes.content:
Quick patch addressing some issues found

Changelog:
- The default settings are now at High instead of Epic
- Added a sensitivity slider to the options
- Fixed instances where the Kidnapper could get stuck
- Fixed a bug where the Anomaly Overload achievement wouldn't work
- Fixed a softlock that could happen if you go to sleep early right before 6 AM
- Fixed a bug where the kidnapper wouldn't despawn if the nightmare ending was triggered
- You can now pause in computer mode
- You can now use Q and E to switch cameras and A and D to switch camera sets
- Fixed a bug where if you open a door and the kidnapper spots you at the same time the game would allow you to walk during the jumpcare
